The '''EE-2MAG Blaster Pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Cartel Market" /> It was a variant of the standard [[EE-2 blaster pistol]].
